zh-CN.title: 图片预览信息更完整
items: 聊天与记录搜索的图片预览统一展示发送者、时间和图片序号，支持跳转原消息
修复照片地图被图片预览遮挡的问题，关闭地图后继续浏览照片

en.title: More context in photo previews
items: Chat and search photo previews show sender, time and position, with a shortcut to the original message
Photo maps now open above the preview and return you to the photo when closed
